Her reference, in words

The picture she sent (it did not come through the link; this is the card's description of it)

A cartoon frog standing tall and front-on; a big round pale-cream belly filling the whole front of the torso; long slim legs that bow OUT at the knees and come back in to the feet, the feet splayed with round toe pads; one arm bent with the hand on the hip, the other hand resting on the belly; a small body, big round white eyes close together on top of a wide head, a wide thin smile; green with a lighter underside. Laura, 11/1: "same vibe" as this picture, but "NOT the dots". The fan stays, the face stays the family face, every limb grows out of the body as one silhouette.

What the drawing takes, and what it keeps

  • Taken: the long-legged standing stance (the legs bow out at the knees and come back in to the feet, the feet splayed with round toe pads); the hand-on-hip attitude; the big cream belly as the whole front of the torso, soft edge, no stripes; a smaller body under the same head.
  • Not taken: the dark spots on the thighs; the reference's round-eyed face (hers stays the family face: the half-lidded eyes with the lashes on the outer top of each dome, the blush, the nostrils, the thin smile, the lighter muzzle); the reference's hand on the belly (her other hand keeps the fan up by her head).
  • Kept from the drawing she has: the fan, the face, the tilt of the head, the colours, the frame.

Her rules, answered

1THE STANCE: long legs, bowed out at the knees, no dots

Her reference: long slim legs that bow OUT at the knees and come back in to the feet. Her word: NOT the dots.

THE LEGS

The legs grow out of the hips, run down and out to a rounded knee, and come back in to the ankle, the calf on the outside; both feet point outward on the floor. No spots. The thigh, the knee, the shin, the ankle and the foot are one silhouette with one outline.

2THE BELLY: the whole front of the torso

Her reference: a big round pale-cream belly filling the whole front of the torso. The sisters' bellies are the model: soft edge, no stripes.

THE BELLY

One cream oval on the front of a smaller torso: it starts under the chin between green shoulders, is widest at the tummy, and ends above the thighs. Soft edge, no outline, no stripes. The body under the head is smaller than before, the reference's way.

3THE HAND ON THE HIP

Her reference: one arm bent with the hand on the hip. Her rule: no outline across the wrist; the palm widens out of the forearm.

THE HAND ON THE HIP

The elbow stands out, the forearm comes back in to the hip, and the palm widens out of the wrist in one shape; four fingers spread over the hip with their pads and the webbing between. The hand stands in front of the hip, so it keeps its own outline there; at the wrist there is none.

4THE SHOULDERS: every limb out of the body as one silhouette

Her rule (the same as the reclining notes): no outline across the shoulders.

THE SHOULDERS

Each shoulder is a round the torso's top line runs onto, and the arm leaves it as one tube: the line from under the chin flows over the shoulder and down the arm with no break and no notch. The armpit is the only crease.

5THE FAN HAND, THE FEET

Her rule: no outline across the wrists or the ankles; the fan stays; the feet splayed with round toe pads.

THE FAN HAND
THE FEET

The fan hand widens out of its forearm and holds the fan's pivot, the fingers over its base, the fan behind. Each shin narrows into the ankle and the foot grows out of it, splayed, four toes with round pads, the toe nearest the floor pointing most down.

What stayed

THE FACE

For your word

  • The legs. They are slim, as the reference's are. Thicker is one number for the thigh and one for the shin.
  • The belly's top. The cream starts under the chin between green shoulders, her sisters' way. If you want it up to the chin, or wider at the chest, say so.
  • The hand on the hip. Four fingers spread over the hip. Three, or curled round the hip, is one line of angles.
  • The knees. Each knee is a round knob where the thigh turns into the shin. Smoother is one number.
  • Your picture. It did not reach us through the link. If it comes through the chat, it comes to this pass.
